steps.content: Oliver didn't actually get far before stopped in place, and the celebratory grin on the kid's face after shaking off the tiredness was nowhere to be seen.
Where to go next? Go straight to find Eve? She must be very weak now... Or wait for the rag doll to create a miracle? Then escape amidst the chaos?
Good.
It's not out of guilt or regret. That doll is too desperate to save his companion. Following him will not end well.
steps.female_content: It's not out of guilt or regret. That doll is too desperate to save her companion. Following her will not end well.

steps.content: But the doll's last words almost threw Oliver off balance... If it weren't for the speedy escape, Oliver would have been caught out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Eve and her family are always there for each other. Even if they've become toys, they still want to protect Eve. But you..."
Is Oliver... just a selfish and cunning bad egg?
Oliver didn't have a chance to figure it out. The warning of "you can't defeat Eve" was fulfilled too quickly.
In the darkness, several toy hoses fly out. They tie Oliver's limbs and suspend the kid in mid-air, leaving dozens of marks on the kid's wrists and ankles.
Oliver's good sis Eve, enveloped in an unfamiliar black aura, slowly emerges from the dark corridor...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Are you alone? Where's the doll that was with you?

At night, it's colder inside the factory than outside by the Rust. The kid's voice is trembling instinctively. The Eve before Oliver almost seems like a stranger, appearing more like a doll than a person. It takes Oliver a long time to regain composure and put on the usual air of arrogance.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: That doll, he's unreliable. He's not obedient at all. Oliver doesn't want him anymore.
steps.female_content: That doll, she's unreliable. She's not obedient at all. Oliver doesn't want her anymore.

steps.content: A hose tightens around Oliver's throat. The contaminated miasma swirls around Eve's ear, seemingly whispering something to her. Eve shakes her head and sighs.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Oliver... do you remember why you were kept here in the first place?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Because these toys could no longer satisfy your twisted tastes? Ugh!!!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: No, no... because you and I are the same.
Eve shows no emotional fluctuations. She still sits in her wheelchair, watching coldly, unscathed.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: How so? Because we're both Sinners?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Sinners? I don't care about that...
Her frail fingers easily snap the Mania thread in her hand.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Haven't you realized it yet, Oliver... we're the same because we were both abandoned.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: No one to depend on. Nowhere to belong.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I made a home and kindly shared it with you, but you don't seem to need it.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Indeed, you don't know how lovely it is to have a home, how wonderful it is to have a family.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Because you've never had them... You only have yourself. It was like that before and it's the same now.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Bah!!!
Oliver spits out a mouthful of bloody saliva.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Keep those good things for yourself, then! Everything will disappear in the end anyways! Ugh!!!
The plastic hose suddenly tightens. Oliver hears the crisp sound of a wrist bone breaking.
Oliver gave a retort instinctively, but all that occupies the kid's mind right now are the rag doll's words: "You can't win against Eve".
A black aura of grief and numbness swirls around Eve. This Eve is nothing like the one Oliver knew.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You know... when you passed by here saying you wanted to be taken in, I thought, Maresa would definitely be happy.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: She lost her own child, so she always gave her love to children your age.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: If she were still here, maybe you really could have joined this family. She would have treated you like her own child.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: But she's not here... Eve is just sleep talking...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I know... so I can't let anyone destroy this dream. Once we wake up, there will be nothing left...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Tell me, where is the doll in the grey clothes?
Oliver gathers the courage to look directly into Eve's cold eyes, and with the last bit of strength, the kid tells a final lie.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: I... don't... know...
Thud! There's no sign of Oliver in the corridor anymore. What lands on the ground with a thud is a unicorn doll.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Is that so... then you're of no use to me.
The wheelchair rolls over the doll.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Poor thing... a child who has never had a home, won't understand this place.
The wheelchair leaves the doll and heads towards the warehouse.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Haha... home, huh...
Oliver still seems to have a sliver of consciousness. The unicorn doll seems to be sobbing in the dust. Or perhaps it's twitching in the direction of Chief, seeking help.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mmm...
You can't speak, and everything in front of you is pitch black. It seems you've passed out again. You're almost out of strength...
The clatter of nesting dolls hitting the ground seems to have stopped. Have you won?
In your daze, you feel a human hand picking you up, fiddling with some strange tool on your body, and even untying the thread that binds your mouth.
Is this person helping you? The wounds on your body seem to have been patched up, greatly relieving your pain.
It doesn't seem to be a dream. You've regained some strength, and try to open your eyes...

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Chief, you're awake!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Sob... I've missed you so much!!!
The big face of a blonde girl zooms into view, rubbing against you several times.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pe... Pepper?
Her eyes are filled with tears as she nods and hands you over to a stranger.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: By the way, I brought a new friend for you! This is Eureka! She's an inventor!
Unlike Oliver, Eureka doesn't try to hide her Sinner identity. You see various strange devices on her, all made with the help of her power.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Was it you who fixed me just now?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: And helped Pepper change back, too!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Amazing! We've been wandering around here for half a day and couldn't find a solution. Gotta leave it to an inventor!
Eureka is a bit taken off guard by the sudden praise.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: No, no... I didn't do much... This place is actually already very fragile, like a wafer biscuit.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Huh? Fragile?
Eureka nods. She finds a simple way to explain and continues.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Do you remember how you got your human body back?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: I remember! This factory seemed to break down for a moment!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Yes. The person who turns everyone into toys... her power is very unstable. I don't know if Chief did something, but that person is very tired right now.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Wow! Even without Pepper, Chief caused such a big impact. As expected of Chief!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I squeezed you in with me when that temporary breakdown happened, and exploited the loophole to turn human.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: So it should be easy to turn rag doll Chief back into human form as well.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: I get it! We just need another momentary breakdown!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: But... how do we do that?
Two pairs of eyes gaze at you earnestly. Your small rag doll body bears heavy expectations.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Perhaps, on your way here, you've encountered some very special toys?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They aren't like Pepper or myself, who got turned into toys unexpectedly. They were toys from the start, who got bestowed personalities, memories, and abilities by Eve, the owner of this factory...
Before you finish your sentence, your attention is drawn to the nesting doll in the dark corner. Isn't this the one you just knocked over?
She has been lying alone at the bottom of the bed where no one cared, chanting something over and over again.
You signal Pepper and Eureka to keep it down, and quietly approach the nesting doll.

steps.speaker: Nesting Doll
steps.content: Child... child...

steps.speaker: Nesting Doll
steps.content: Where's Eve? Did she go out? Did she help me find my child?
The nesting doll has lost her instinct to attack, and is mechanically expressing the identity and memories that Eve bestowed upon her...

steps.speaker: Nesting Doll
steps.content: I turned around to buy some candy, and he was gone the next second!

steps.speaker: Nesting Doll
steps.content: He was so young... so little... where could he have gone?

steps.speaker: Nesting Doll
steps.content: Should I have not gone... to buy him candy?

steps.speaker: Nesting Doll
steps.content: He should be twelve or thirteen by now, right? Was he sold to a gang... Will he resent me?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: What is this doll talking about?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I don't know, but it must be something very important.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Pepper held out till now thanks to her strong desire of finding the Chief.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: This nesting doll must also be supported by some strong wish.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: The Chief you mentioned is the same. I just did a simple repair on him, and I could feel it.
steps.female_content: The Chief you mentioned is the same. I just did a simple repair on her, and I could feel it.

steps.content: Pepper seems to realize something interesting and looks at you, who is still holding out.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Does Chief also have a strong wish? What is it?

options: Finding a way to save you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You jumped into the conveyor belt exit and completely lost connection the next second. I almost thought you got made into Pepper lamb kebabs...
Pepper lets out a muffled laugh and scratches her head bashfully...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eureka, you just mentioned that what spurs the toys to move is the power of their wishes. This power is getting weaker and weaker, and we could try to trigger a breakdown again, right?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Right. Is there a problem?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like I just said, the toy family members are special. They are toys that were originally lifeless. How can they have wishes of their own?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Is that so? Perhaps I'm mistaken...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, your conjecture is correct. But what supports them is the wish of their maker, Eve.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But... if that's the case, what I've done to Eve shouldn't be able to shake her wish. There must be another reason as to why her power is unstable...
As you instinctively remember the symbol from the Underground, Eureka suddenly shouts out loud...

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Eureka! I got it!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Huh? What did you realize?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: The secret behind the unstable power!
